defect: two external clocks lack an architectural relationship
rationale: Equal declared periods do not establish phase coupling; the board clock architecture is absent, so neither asynchronous grouping nor related timing can be justified.
author: gpt-6.1-sol

labels.by: claude-opus-5-5 (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: The two 10 ns clocks are declared with no phase or relationship, so STA assumes they are synchronous and in phase, which may be false for the live launch->result path.
